title: Demonstrate the simplified evaluation flow on a small and a substantive change once the host ships same-session re-evaluation
outcome: Demonstrate the simplified evaluation flow on a small and a substantive change once the host ships same-session re-evaluation
acceptance: both demonstrations keep criterion coverage, evaluator independence where the policy requires it, changed-input invalidation and honest evidence attribution, and their delegation records are cited on this item with the count of evaluator sessions each used

on a small correction, an insufficient_evidence verdict is answered by new evidence and the same evaluator session records a new whole passing record under a fresh attempt key, with no new evaluator session spawned; the item seals
on a substantive change, a fail is answered by a source correction and the re-evaluation makes a whole new inspection of the moved source, bound checks included; the item seals
